==Description==
The '''Mega Clanker''' was an enemy that appeared in the fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It was very similar to the [[Clanker]], but it had more health and was slower. It was also a lead enemy, reducing the amount of towers you could use.

==Appearance==
The '''Mega Clanker''' was a mechanical humanoid out of black and orange-yellow metal. Its appearance was a mix of steampunk and normal machinery. It had a cross on its face.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers that can damage lead enemies are recommended, such as the Level 3+ [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]].
**You can use the [[Commander]] to boost the firerate of these towers.
*The [[Ace Pilot]] can damage it with bombs, and the [[Pursuit]] can damage this with missiles, however due to their low damage they are not recommended.
*You can use slowing towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Toxic Gunner]] or [[Sledger]] to slow this down.
**The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can also be used to damage them, however the damage dealt is quite low.

==Trivia==
*The name of the '''Mega Clanker''' may be a reference to ''Star Wars'', as the [[w:c:starwars:Clone Trooper|Clone Troopers]] often call the [[w:c:starwars:Droid|Droids]] a ''Clanker''.
*This alongside the [[Clanker]] are the first lead enemies that do not appear in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
